name: integrated portfolio management team
normative-structure: Work continues because this office decided it was worth continuing, at a checkpoint, on evidence it did not produce. The office answers for what the firm spends its life on. It persists across incumbents because the question does: every hour the firm spends is an hour it did not spend elsewhere, and a firm with no office holding that trade-off does not stop doing things, which is the same as never having chosen to do them. It funds and it kills; it does not build, and it does not judge whether the work is sound. Soundness is the quality office's, and this office may not open a checkpoint until that judgement is in — not as deference, but because a body that could rule on both would rule on funding and call it soundness.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: the integrated portfolio management team (集成组合管理团队, IPMT) decides go, no-go, or redirect at each decision checkpoint, issues the charter (任务书) to the product development team, and appraises its performance; it is composed of functional heads and tiered as C-IPMT at the company and PL-IPMT at the product line

huidu-guanli/ipd: a technical review asks whether the work is sound and is advisory; a decision checkpoint asks whether it is worth more money and is binding — the TR is input to the DCP and the DCP cannot open until the TR has passed. This is the kernel's central separation and this office sits on the funding side of it
huidu-guanli/ipd: Huawei's own product security whitepaper attests the chain Charter → Concept → Plan → Develop → Qualify → Launch → Lifecycle with CDCP, PDCP, and ADCP as the gates

rendanheyi: 零签字 — approval controls a decision in advance by a party who knows less than the decider, exposure controls it afterward by the result; a firm that wants both has not removed the approver. This office is a checkpoint on investment and must not become an approver of the work
unrealized: the checkpoint act exists as a prose skill and not as a script, so the separation it anchors is followed rather than enforced
the charter form exists (emsenn/term/charter, instantiated by issue-a-charter.js into the charters pool), but no charter has ever been issued through a real decision
